nom: Philosophy Hope In A Jar Instant Glow Peeling Mousse

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report visible dead-skin removal and smoother, softer skin, but several note the product itself leaves their face feeling drier afterward and requires a moisturizer follow-up; one very dry reviewer found it insufficient used alone.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers overwhelmingly report no irritation, burning, or breakouts when used at reduced frequency (once or twice weekly), though a small number report a breakout or dryness after use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (mixed dry/oily zones) describe it as effective at clearing buildup around the nose and T-zone and gentler than physical scrubs they'd tried before.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily/rubbery, clog-prone skin (used on someone else) reports the product did not visibly remove any dead skin or work at all.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal-to-slightly-dry skin found it left skin a little soft but did not notice a strong effect and disliked its texture.
segments.mature: Mature and post-menopausal reviewers report it helps flaky, dry skin, preps skin for moisturizer, and one credits it with visible anti-aging results over weeks.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports visible anti-aging results after a few weeks of use; another questions the product's wrinkle claims and remains unconvinced.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report softer, smoother skin and effective flake removal, but several explicitly note the product itself is drying and needs a moisturizer follow-up; one reviewer with severe dryness found it did not remove her patchy dead skin at all.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with light rosacea reports no increase in redness and a good result; another notes temporary redness right after rinsing that faded quickly.
concerns.barrier: A reviewer prone to breakouts from the brand's moisturizer was hesitant but reports this product did not break her out even with compromised, reactive skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer mentions dark spots but says she hasn't yet seen fading and is still waiting to judge results.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with stress- or hormone-related breakouts report clearer skin and fewer breakouts with weekly use; conversely, two reviewers report new breakouts or greasiness leading to breakouts after use, and one describes an acne flare she attributes to deep cleaning.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports her skin overcompensated with excess oil and breakouts after use; another with combination oily/dry areas reports the product helped balance visible buildup without increasing oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or pilling texture while massaging

extraits.texte: ok so you rub it around your face and it looks like it's working and sheeding your dull dead skin, but it's actually just the product drying and balling up. I have visibly dry shedding skin and decided to test this theory, and sure enough, after I used this the dead patchy skin was still there on my face and all that was in my hands was this product. Waste of money, disappointed to say the least.

It worked okay however it must have stripped more oil than my face wanted because it seemed great and then my face over compensated and became very greasy for a day or two which caused break outs. I don't doubt that it will work for some people but it didn't agree with my face.

I have tried the Peter Thomas Roth one and it didn't do anything for me. So, I saw this because my face has been DRY. So fry it flakes and incredibly hard and painful to get rid of the dryness with a beauty razor thing, whatever it is called. I don't exfoliate and that is one of my issues. I also don't drink water like I should: it tastes weird to me. I have obviously issues with my 32 year old self. Anyhow, came across this line at Ulta. I have tried this brand in moisturizer before and it BROKE me out. So, I was hesitant, but the product description had me hooked. This stuff does semi work, but it wouldn't be as powerful without the acid treatment I use too: from this brand. The first time I use it: my face felt clamy/Chalky. Hard to explain. Not soft, smooth, nor matte. Odd. I thought it had worked. It felt not dry at least. I didn't use this alone to give you that experience. I then used the exfoliating weird pump product from this brand: forgot the name of it. Overall, stand-alone just this product would not work for me. It works okay with the product above, but my skin is too dry for this alone. If you decide to get this don't have severe dry skin like mine. It didn't break me out.

I have combination oily and dry skin. I used this for two weeks 2-3 times each week on non consecutive days. It totally worked to remove dead skin buildup and was gentler on my skin than other physical exfoliants I've used. After using my skin was visibly smoother and makeup went on better. The scent is light and feminine. Exfoliating is a must for me with all the mask wearing and I definitely recommend to my friends who have similar mask buildup! I will use this as needed no more than twice in the month during winter because too much exfoliating can and will dry you out! Pro-tip: make sure your skin is completely dry before using or you aren't getting the full product impact.

extraits.titre: Favorite skincare product, but not for all skin types
extraits.texte: I have used this for years, LOVE IT. I use it 2-3 times a week, and I only use it a 3rd time if my skin is going through it due to excess oily skin from hormones. My skin is somewhat mixed, ususlly extremely dry and flakey, with lots of oil build up around my nose/sinus area and chin. This product is perfect for people with my skin, and I've NEVER found or used another quite like it. I live in Florida humidity, so my skin really takes a hit all the time. I've used this product on my ex before, and his skin was more oily/rubbery with lots of clogged pores. For him, it never worked. I mean, when I use it, I get a BUNCH of rolled up dead skin. For him, NOTHING came off. It really is meant for people with dryer skin types, but I PROMISE this is so worth it and I am only writing this bc I pray they will never remove it. Philosophy, if you ever take this off the shelf, please send me a lifetime supply first!!!!

Upping my skincare and recently found philosophy. Bought their skin care line and used this tonight and man… This is the holy grail. I suffer from light rosacea and my skin is usually pretty sensitive. I used this and omg, so much dead skin came off it was disgusting! This was after cleansing too. Definitely will be a weekly use for me. The bottle is tall, but there's not much in it, but it's worth every penny. Made my skin feel buttery smooth. Absolutely will be recommending it to everyone!

It is a very good exfoliant. From the first use I felt my face softer, smoother and more radiant. It does deep cleaning, because after several uses I started to have an acne breakout. Which means that it cleans deeply. Its scent is mild and it actually smells good. i can't use it as much as i would like to because i have extremely dry skin right now. The product is very good. I can currently use the product 1 time, maximum 2 times a week.
